name: The Great Fire
source:
You are Frankie, an usher at the Orpheum Cinema in Mayhem, a small country town in 1950s Australia. Today begins like any other day at work, but soon you will discover that it is a day you will never forget.

[From [url=https://moralityplay.itch.io/the-great-fire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Frankie，是20世纪50年代澳大利亚乡村小镇Mayhem的Orpheum电影院的引座员。今天开始就像工作中的任何其他一天一样，但很快你就会发现这是你永远不会忘记的一天。

[来自[url=https://moralityplay.itch.io/the-great-fire]Itch.io[/url]]
